sentences.text: Social worker Rachel Burns (S1) and District nurse Siobhan Kelly (S3) were present with Keith Dawson (S2) on Friday 27 November 2026.
District nurse Siobhan Kelly (S3) stated she was worried about how things were at home.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated he lives in a house rented from a housing association.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated he rang the housing association once but nobody came.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated his GP is Dr Morgan at Holloway surgery and he has not been for ages.
District nurse Siobhan Kelly (S3) reported seeing Keith Dawson (S2) twice a week for leg ulcers on both legs, which she described as slow to heal.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated the boiler had packed up and there had been no heating since October.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated there was no hot water.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated he uses a fan heater but does not put it on because it costs a fortune.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated he is not managing well with washing because there is no hot water.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated he had not washed in three or four weeks.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated there are rats in the kitchen and he has seen two.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated the rats have been at the bread for a few weeks.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated he keeps food in tins now because of the rats.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated he eats soup and beans mostly out of the tin.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated carers were supposed to do him a meal.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated he has a home care package called Bright Days for morning and teatime.
District nurse Siobhan Kelly (S3) stated the log book showed there should have been 28 visits in the last two weeks, but 16 were missed with nothing written for those visits.
District nurse Siobhan Kelly (S3) stated there were four days last week when no one came at all.
District nurse Siobhan Kelly (S3) stated Keith Dawson (S2) told her he had no meal on those four days.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated nobody turned up and he did not ring them because he did not want the bother.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated he wants the heating fixed and the rats gone.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated it would be nice to have a bath.
Neighbour at number twenty-five told District nurse Siobhan Kelly (S3) that Keith Dawson (S2) has been drinking heavily.
District nurse Siobhan Kelly (S3) stated she had not seen any sign of heavy drinking herself; it was only what the neighbour told her.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated the neighbour is a 'nosy cow' and he is not getting into it.
Social worker Rachel Burns (S1) asked Keith Dawson (S2) if he would agree to her raising a safeguarding concern about the care visits and the state of the house.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated he would agree if the boiler gets done.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated his brother Phil is in Northby and they talk at Christmas.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated his wife left in 2015.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated he lives on ESA and is waiting on his pension next year.
Keith Dawson (S2) stated he thinks he is up to date with bills and that the gas is on a meter.
Social worker Rachel Burns (S1) stated she would ring the housing association and log the boiler as an emergency repair.
Social worker Rachel Burns (S1) stated she would ask for two oil heaters to be dropped off today or tomorrow.
Social worker Rachel Burns (S1) stated she would contact environmental health for pest control in the kitchen.
Social worker Rachel Burns (S1) stated she would raise the missed visits with Bright Days and the commissioning team today.
District nurse Siobhan Kelly (S3) stated she would keep coming on Tuesdays and Fridays for the legs and let Keith Dawson (S2) know if visits are still being missed.
Social worker Rachel Burns (S1) stated she would arrange a review of Keith Dawson's (S2) care package and an occupational therapy assessment for the bathroom.
Social worker Rachel Burns (S1) asked Keith Dawson (S2) if she could ask Dr Morgan to see him.
Keith Dawson (S2) agreed to Dr Morgan seeing him.
Social worker Rachel Burns (S1) stated she would come back on Thursday 3 December at two to check the boiler is done and the agency is turning up.
